subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose `models.providers.*.retry` now, or should retry stay on the canonical configurable LLM retry/backoff issue until the runtime contract is implemented?
rationale: The retry schema/help/type surface is public config but intentionally has no runtime behavior in this branch, so automation cannot choose whether to remove it, fully implement it, or pause for broader API design.

options.title: Split retry out before merge
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry semantics on the open canonical retry issue while reviewing only the scoped timeout change.

options.title: Implement retry fully here
options.body: Wire provider retry into the model-call path with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, config docs/baseline, and focused runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause behind retry design
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it if maintainers want the retry and timeout API direction settled together before adding new provider config surface.

recommendation.title: Split retry out before merge
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry semantics on the open canonical retry issue while reviewing only the scoped timeout change.
